frozen: 2026-09-28, before any result of this protocol was observed

fixture.description: Original CC0 FR/EN news briefs from THE-553; rows are [id, title, body, language, query]
fixture.judgments: binary; each query has exactly one relevant Record, the fixture row with the same id
fixture.ingestion: public POST /v0/records, Manifest with Parts title(role title) and body(role body), one fresh Corpus, no other Records in that Corpus

declared_hardware.inference: local TEI, CPU, float32, pinned E5 small snapshot
declared_hardware.note: Actual CPU, memory and Docker resources are recorded per run; results apply only to the recorded run

metrics.mrr_at_10: mean over queries of 1/rank of the relevant Record in the top 10, 0 when absent
metrics.recall_at_3: fraction of queries whose relevant Record ranks 1..3
metrics.recall_at_10: fraction of queries whose relevant Record ranks 1..10

latency.order: for each pass, the 24 queries in a seeded shuffle; for each query, the three modes in a seeded shuffle
latency.measure: client wall time from request start to parsed JSON body, milliseconds
latency.percentiles: nearest-rank over successful samples; non-200 responses and timeouts are counted as failures and never dropped

target.primary: each mode under the sequential condition (simple search)
target.secondary: concurrent-4 and ingesting cells are compared with the same target for this workload only

concurrent_ingestion.corpus: a second fresh Corpus, so fixture scope and judgments are unchanged
concurrent_ingestion.text_template: Bulletin synthétique {i} : la commune de Testville publie son relevé hebdomadaire numéro {i}, sans lien avec les autres dépêches.
concurrent_ingestion.repeat_until: all measured latency samples of the ingesting condition are collected; the stream restarts with new record keys if it finishes first

phases: prepare: tokenizer, pinned model files, go build and image pull (cold only when caches are empty)
cold_start: compose up --wait, migrations, API and worker readiness
cold_model_ready: first successful semantic search on the cold stack
warm_start: same start after removing the project and its volumes, with cached images and model
warm_model_ready: first successful semantic search on the warm stack
limits: 24 short single-segment documents; no Agency-scale, multi-architecture or production relevance claim
one run on shared hardware; no stability claim across runs
relevance weights and fixture are not tuned here; hybrid relevance belongs to THE-641
